Frequently Asked Questions (Wholesale & Markup)

What is the difference between Markup % and Profit Margin %?

Markup is profit divided by Landed Cost (e.g., $10 cost sold for $25 = 150% markup), while Gross Margin is profit divided by Selling Price ($15 / $25 = 60% gross margin).

Why must DTC brands calculate wholesale margin from Day 1?

If you price a $10 landed item at $22 DTC, you cannot later offer retailers a standard 50% wholesale price ($11) without wiping out your profit. Aiming for 4x–4.5x landed COGS keeps both DTC and wholesale doors open.
